steps.summary: Fourteen ad-hoc font sizes and four weights became a five-step ladder with two weights, so headings are found by size and tier instead of by boldness.

changes.what: Font sizes on the page, collapsed onto a ladder of roles
Font weights in use
Headline figures no longer shout over their labels
Section headings one rank up, carried by size and tracking rather than weight
Sidebar group labels in sentence case
Page paths set in the text face instead of a monospace
Section descriptions read as supporting copy, not captions
Webfont request trimmed, with a metric-matched fallback so the swap doesn't move text

steps.summary: The greys were re-derived for measured contrast, and colour now marks only what needs a person: one indigo for links and focus, red for the two real problems.

changes.what: Timestamps, captions and axis labels became readable
changes.after: #60636a — 6.02:1 on the page, 5.36:1 on its worst surface

changes.what: The search field's edge can be seen
The current nav item is marked by position and weight, not the brand colour
changes.before: indigo text on an indigo tint
changes.after: ink text at 500 on a neutral pill, with aria-current

changes.what: Rising figures stop being coloured; only the conversion drop stays red
changes.before: 3 green chips at 3.93:1, 1 red chip at 4.54:1
changes.after: 3 ink chips at 15.38:1, 1 red chip at 5.13:1

changes.what: The chart's current period drawn in ink, freeing indigo for actions
changes.before: indigo line and indigo area fill
changes.after: ink line; previous period dashed grey raised from 1.85:1 to 3.12:1

changes.what: Routine feed events lose their colour; only the alert keeps red
changes.before: 4 coloured icons (green, indigo, red, plus grey)

changes.what: The 61.3% bounce rate no longer relies on colour alone
changes.after: a red chip with an alert glyph and screen-reader text

changes.what: Light page and dark page re-picked
changes.before: light page #f6f7f9 under white cards; dark page #0b0d12 (L 0.16)
changes.after: light page white, cards equal and edged; dark page #0f1216 (L 0.18)

steps.summary: A mosaic of seven boxes became a stacked page: a header bar, a strip of figures, a column of sections beside an activity rail, all on one spacing and radius ladder.

changes.what: Boxes in the content area
changes.before: 7 (4 stat tiles, chart, table and activity cards)

changes.what: Stat tiles became one row of figures parted by hairlines, each figure over its label
The header became a slim bar: breadcrumb, then the page title at the nav's size, actions at the end
changes.before: ≈ 79px tall, title 22px on its own line, bordered 38px controls
changes.after: 52px tall, title 13px inline after the breadcrumb, 32px ghost buttons

changes.what: Headings sit closer to what they introduce
changes.after: 32px above a section, 12px under its heading (≈ 2.7:1)

changes.what: Corner radii on one nesting ladder
changes.after: 3 radii (4 / 6 / 10px) plus pills for dots and tracks

changes.what: Lines drawn by job
changes.before: 1px borders everywhere, dividers the same colour as edges
changes.after: 0.5px hairlines; dividers a colour step lighter than edges

changes.what: Chips share one shape
Stacking and breakpoints named for what they do
changes.before: z-index 5 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 typed raw; 4 window breakpoints; no skip link
changes.after: 4 named rungs; 3 breakpoints (shell on the window, rail and narrow on the panel); skip link to #main

steps.summary: Every surface now sits on one of four named levels, the header is opaque, and dark mode lifts menus by lightening them instead of leaning on shadows.

changes.what: The sticky header is opaque
changes.before: 82% tint with blur(12px) saturate(180%), no fallback
changes.after: solid page colour, hairline edge, raised shadow

changes.what: Shadows reduced to one recipe per level
changes.before: 5 distinct shadows (3 tokens plus 2 inline), on cards, tiles and controls
changes.after: 4 level tokens: raised, floating, transient tooltip, overlay

changes.what: Floating surfaces carry their edge inside the shadow, and keep it in forced colours
changes.after: 0.5px ring at the head of the shadow, transparent 1px border, solid under prefers-contrast: more

changes.what: Dark menus and the nav sheet lift by lightening
changes.before: menu #12151c, the same as every card

changes.what: Controls drop their decorative shadows
changes.after: 0 — flat controls use their edge only

changes.what: Closing the mobile nav returns focus to the menu button
changes.after: on Escape, scrim click or button

steps.summary: Timings now follow one ladder set by how much of the screen changes, exits are quicker than entrances, and reduced motion swaps travel for fades instead of switching everything off.

changes.what: Durations on a ladder
One easing curve, plus one for colour and one for exits
changes.before: ease, ease-out and the browser default mixed
changes.after: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); ease-out for colour; ease-in for exits

changes.what: The date menu closes faster than it opens
The mobile nav sheet gets out of the way
Reduced motion keeps the signal
changes.before: a global rule turning every transition and animation off
changes.after: menu and sheet fade instead of travelling; washes and exits stay

changes.what: Press feedback lands on press
changes.after: a pressed step at 0ms on nav rows, buttons and menu options

steps.summary: The words were made to agree with each other and with assistive tech: one name for the comparison period, one shape for see-more links, and Escape closing one layer at a time.

changes.what: One phrase for the comparison period
changes.before: "prior 30 days" (4×) beside "Previous period" in the chart

changes.what: See-more links name what they show
The workspace switcher's spoken name includes what's on screen
Escape closes one layer
changes.before: Escape in the date menu could also close the nav sheet
changes.after: the menu stops the key; the next Escape closes the sheet

changes.what: The notifications button says there is something unread, with a tooltip
changes.before: "Notifications", no tooltip, unread shown by a dot only
